says: Three books, Dune read: every row has a Remove button in one column at the right edge. Removing Dune (read) moves the rows up and the summary goes from "2 of 3 unread" to "2 of 2 unread"; removing Emma (unread) gives "1 of 1 unread"; removing Hyperion, the last book, leaves an empty list with "0 of 0 unread".
